name: Tsui Tsui ~Twintail Twins~
original_name: ついつい～ツインテールツインズ～
source:
Main character is a private school teacher. Twin sisters who live next door deliberately choose the same school and protagonist's class. Two more students suddenly transfer and take the nearby flat, and they also show up at protagonist's class. Main character becomes sandwiched between all these twins searching for his attention.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位私立学校的老师。住在隔壁的双胞胎姐妹故意选择同一所学校和主角所在的班级。又有两名学生突然转学，住进了附近的公寓，也出现在主角的班级里。主角被夹在所有这些双胞胎之间寻求他的注意力。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
